annotations.title: ECB policy rates, euro short rate and euro yield curve

description: ECB policy rates, euro short rate and euro yield curve — European Central Bank rates in one call from the official ECB Data Portal: deposit facility, main refinancing and marginal lending rates with the date and size of the last change, deposit rate a year ago and policy stance; euro short-term rate (EURSTR) with 1-month average and spread to the deposit rate; euro area AAA government spot yield curve (3M, 1Y, 2Y, 5Y, 10Y, 30Y) with 2s10s spread, curve shape (NORMAL / FLAT / INVERTED) and 1-month change. No params. Pairs with /v1/finance/rates (US rates). Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_ecb_rates
